[[File:Tournaments.decipher.com November 2001.jpg|thumb|tournaments.decipher.com, November 2001.]]
'''tournaments.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host. In 2001 it ran the Decipher TCG Tournament System, with a tournament locator, player ratings and director logins.<ref name="t">[http://tournaments.decipher.com/ Decipher TCG Tournaments], Decipher (November 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011112102743/http://tournaments.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
